summary: Retest of backend identity-comparison fix and frontend server.js refactor (named handlers + constants). All 5 acceptance criteria verified healthy: no bug is/is not misuse remains (only intentional mongo_client is not None), handleRequest decomposed into resolveStaticFile/serveStaticFile with complexity 4 (<=10), semantic constants confirmed in server.js, routing behavior (200/200/405/404/403) preserved, and production build + public health/browser regression checks pass.

checks.criterion: Backend identity comparisons use correct semantics
checks.name: backend-identity-comparison-grep
checks.evidence: grep -rn ' is | is not ' backend/*.py (excluding pycache) -> no bare literal identity comparisons found; only occurrence of 'is not None' is db.py:146 'if app.state.mongo_client is not None:' preceded by comment confirming intentional None-singleton check.

checks.criterion: Frontend request handler complexity is below the reported threshold
checks.name: server-js-handler-decomposition-review
checks.evidence: frontend/server.js: http.createServer(handleRequest) at line 61; handleRequest (lines 54-59, 4 branches: API prefix check, method check, delegates to serveStaticFile) calls resolveStaticFile (37-43) and serveStaticFile (45-52) as separate named functions. Direct complexity estimate for handleRequest is 4, within the <=10 threshold.

checks.name: server-js-constants-review
checks.evidence: frontend/server.js lines 5-16 define DEFAULT_FRONTEND_PORT, BACKEND_PORT, STATUS_OK/STATUS_BAD_GATEWAY/STATUS_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED/STATUS_FORBIDDEN/STATUS_NOT_FOUND, LOOPBACK_HOST, LISTEN_HOST, METHOD_GET, API_PREFIX as named constants; used throughout instead of inline literals.

checks.criterion: Refactored server preserves all routing behavior
checks.name: server-js-routing-curl
checks.evidence: curl http://localhost:3000/ -> 200; curl http://localhost:3000/vendor/qrcode.js -> 200; curl -X PUT http://localhost:3000/ -> 405; curl http://localhost:3000/nonexistent-file.txt -> 404; curl 'http://localhost:3000/..%2f..%2fbackend/.env' -> 403 (traversal rejected); curl http://localhost:8001/api/health (proxied via :3000 in backend-pytest-suite) -> 200.

checks.criterion: Production build and public app have no regression
checks.name: yarn-build-and-regression-checks
checks.evidence: cd frontend && yarn build -> 'Done in 0.07s.' exit 0. Backend pytest: 5 passed in 0.70s. Browser check 'home-explains-offline-audit-flow' reran-persisted -> PASSED. Browser check 'public-reviews-loaded-from-backend' reran-persisted -> PASSED, screenshot captured, no thrown errors.

checks.criterion: Production build and public app have no regression (backend pytest suite)
checks.name: backend-pytest-suite
checks.evidence: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -> '5 passed in 0.70s' (test_tscheck_public_health.py, test_tscheck_reviews_api.py).

checks.criterion: Production build and public app have no regression (public health)
checks.name: public-health-curl
checks.evidence: curl http://localhost:8001/api/health -> 200; matches acceptance criterion for Systemstatus Backend Online (confirmed visually in prior home-explains-offline-audit-flow screenshot).

note: Retest mode: no new UI surface since iteration_8; matrix in this briefing is about a backend db.py identity-comparison audit and a frontend server.js complexity refactor, both static/source-level criteria verified by direct code review + grep plus live curl routing checks. Re-ran the 2 existing browser checks by name only (no script resend) as the general no-regression smoke test, and re-ran the backend pytest suite. All 5 briefing criteria confirmed satisfied with no findings.
